integrity: Proof gives all-vector, all-tolerance statements; finite checker is auxiliary. Priority risk remains for earlier related quantitative recurrence methods; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof applies to strictly positive periodic unilateral forward weights on complex Hilbert sequence space. It does not classify arbitrary nonperiodic, complex-phase, or Banach-space weights, and the two-period counterexample is not an exhaustive convexity classification.
title: Three-regime recurrence radii for periodic weighted forward shifts and a nonconvex critical phase
